entries.name: Bilt
entries.what: Rent rewards and points platform that runs frequent points promos and airline partner offers.
entries.why_fit: Its rent focused rewards model and airline tie ins are a live benchmark for engagement and benefit design that appeals to affluent renters.

history.note: Bilt Rent Day offers up to a 100% bonus on points redeemed for statement credits (normally 0.55 cents per point) and a JetBlue Mosaic status match.
Rent Day promo offers up to a 100% bonus on points redeemed for statement credits (normally 0.55 cents per point) plus a JetBlue Mosaic status match.

entries.name: Etihad
entries.what: Abu Dhabi based premium airline with its own loyalty program.
entries.why_fit: A foreign premium airline entering the US card market is a possible co-brand or benefit partner and a new high fee competitor for affluent cardholders.

history.note: Reported as launching its first credit cards in the US market. The item does not say who the issuer is, so check that before treating it as a competitor win.
Reported to be launching its first credit cards on the US market, adding a new premium competitor and a possible co-brand benefit model.

entries.name: Atmos Rewards
entries.what: Combined Alaska and Hawaiian airline loyalty program with its own premium co-brand cards.
entries.why_fit: A major West Coast airline currency that issuers are actively paying to acquire members for, relevant to any airline benefit or transfer play.

history.note: Bank of America targeted offers rose to 125k points on the Atmos Summit and 90k on the Atmos Ascent. Atmos also has a double points promo on Hawaii flights through March 10, 2027.

entries.name: Rove
entries.what: Loyalty program that has launched personalized shopping offers with in store earning.
entries.why_fit: A loyalty currency with offer based earning could work as an offer or transfer partner for card benefits.

history.note: Launched personalized shopping offers earning up to 25 miles per dollar and expanded in store earning.
Launched personalized shopping offers with up to 25 miles per dollar and expanded in-store earning. Still no issuer deal reported.

entries.name: NetJets
entries.why_fit: Private flying and premier sporting event access match what HNW and UHNW cardholders value, and could support a concierge or flight benefit.

history.note: Named official private aviation provider of the Hahnenkamm Races in Kitzbühel. This is an event sponsorship, not an issuer deal.
Named official private aviation provider of the Hahnenkamm Races in Kitzbühel, a sign of sporting event sponsorship that could point to a concierge or flight benefit angle.

entries.name: Rakuten
entries.what: Cashback shopping portal that pays approval bonuses on partner issuers' credit cards.
entries.why_fit: Shows a third-party portal acting as an acquisition channel for card issuers, which Wells Fargo could use or counter.

history.note: Added approval bonuses on three Citi cards this week: $50 cashback or up to 5,000 Bilt points.

entries.name: Revolut
entries.what: Fintech app that added Virgin Atlantic Velocity Points as a points currency this week.
entries.why_fit: A fintech buying into an airline loyalty ecosystem is a direct partner model worth benchmarking for card benefits.

history.note: Unlocked Velocity Points, tying Revolut to Virgin Atlantic's loyalty program.

entries.name: JetBlue
entries.what: US airline whose Mosaic elite status is being offered through a status match with Bilt.
entries.why_fit: Airline status matches are a concrete benefit design to benchmark for premium card holders.

history.note: Part of the Bilt Rent Day promo, which pairs a JetBlue Mosaic status match with up to a 100% bonus on points redeemed for statement credits.

entries.name: Pagaya
entries.what: AI underwriting provider that powers consumer lending.
entries.why_fit: A possible embedded lending partner for installment and personal loan products.

history.note: Yahoo Finance coverage this week says Wall Street is watching its role in consumer lending. No issuer deal reported.
